name: Note Outline
summary: A note document view with a notebook tree, breadcrumb and content blocks, plus an outline built from the headings that scrolls each one into view.
useWhen: A notes or docs app where long documents need a table of contents that tracks their headings
A knowledge base reader that organizes documents into notebooks and needs to work on a phone
avoidWhen: Editing rich text in place, where forms/editor fits better
Short documents with no headings, where the outline would only be empty
